sources.title: Militär-historisches Kriegs-Lexikon (1618-1905)
sources.author: Gaston Bodart
sources.edition: Wien und Leipzig: C. W. Stern, 1908; Google Books copy A0kNAAAAYAAJ, scanned by Google and held by Internet Archive as bub_gb_A0kNAAAAYAAJ (ABBYY FineReader 9.0 OCR).
sources.archival_identifier: Internet Archive bub_gb_A0kNAAAAYAAJ; Google Books A0kNAAAAYAAJ
sources.rights: Published 1908; Internet Archive marks the item with the Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0. OCR text, OCR page index and search text, page-number map, item metadata and downscaled page images retained.
sources.document_date_note: A 1908 compilation covering 1618-1905; its entries draw on the works listed in its Quellenangabe (pp. 15-32). The compilation date is not an event date.
sources.dependency_note: A compiled secondary tabulation. By its own explanatory notes (pp. 45-47) it includes engagements of significant consequence or with at least 2,000 combined losses, places the winner on the left, assigns a winner even to indecisive battles, gives strengths as the forces available for the battle rather than only those engaged, and rounds figures up to 50 or 100. Arnold's machine-readable Bodart tables (arnold-bodart1908-*) reproduce the same work, so they are one family with it.
sources.inspection: The uncompressed XML matches SHA-1 296c67df9bae96ca58e2bf736dbaccc28ce54115 in the previously pinned IA metadata. Used for provisional bulk extraction; OCR values are not page-image verification. Existing checked transcription takes precedence on pp.268-490.
